message.text:
`internal/scheduler` exists as a library but is only used in its own tests.

No nightly database-cleanup job is scheduled in production. The "0 2 * * *" example in `doc.go` is only a documentation sample. `server/server.go` only starts an S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker, not via cron.
